Mission & Vision

Why Ozylix Exists

India has the world's highest rate of micronutrient deficiency — yet most supplement brands charge a premium that keeps quality nutrition out of reach for millions. We founded Ozylix to break that cycle.

Ascovita Healthcare formulates and manufactures every Ozylix product in its own FSSAI-licensed facility in Anand, Gujarat — effervescent tablets, spirulina, glutathione, biotin and more. Ozylix takes them straight to the customer. One company owns the whole chain, which is why there is no distributor margin in the price.

"From formulation to manufacturing of nutraceutical products — one standard, no shortcuts."

— Ozylix Promise

Privacy Policy

Ozylix | Last Updated: Jan 2025

Ozylix is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information.

Information We Collect

We collect information you provide when placing orders (name, address, phone, email), and non-personally identifiable browsing data to improve our website. We never collect sensitive financial data — all payments are processed by GoKwik's secure gateway.

How We Use Your Data

Your data is used solely to process orders, send tracking information, and (with consent) send promotional emails. We never sell your personal information to any third party.

Contact for Privacy

Email: ascovitahealthcare@gmail.com | Phone: +91 9898 582 650

Refund & Return Policy

7-Day Return Window — We accept returns on sealed, unused products within 7 days of delivery.

Eligible for Return/Refund

  • Damaged or defective products (photo proof required)
  • Wrong item delivered
  • Sealed, unopened products within 7 days of delivery

How to Initiate a Return

Email ascovitahealthcare@gmail.com with your order number, reason for return, and photos (if damaged). We process refunds within 5–7 working days after receiving the returned item.

Non-Returnable Items

Opened supplement packages cannot be returned for hygiene and safety reasons.

Accessibility Statement

Ozylix — Committed to inclusive digital access

Ozylix is committed to ensuring that our website is accessible to people of all abilities, including those with disabilities. We strive to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA standards.

🎨
Visual Accessibility

High contrast colour ratios throughout the site. Text sizes are scalable and all images include descriptive alt text. We avoid relying solely on colour to convey information.

⌨️
Keyboard Navigation

All interactive elements are accessible via keyboard. Tab order follows a logical sequence and focus indicators are visible throughout the site.

📱
Mobile & Touch Accessible

Our site is fully responsive and designed for touch interfaces. Tap targets are adequately sized to ensure ease of use on mobile devices.

🔊
Screen Reader Support

Semantic HTML and ARIA labels are used throughout to support screen readers such as NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver on mobile devices.

🌐
Language & Readability

The site language is declared as English. Content is written in plain language. Line spacing and paragraph widths are optimised for readability.

🎬
Motion & Animation

Animations are kept subtle and non-essential. We respect the user's operating system preference for reduced motion via the prefers-reduced-motion CSS media query.

Known Limitations

We are continuously working to improve accessibility across all pages. Some third-party payment gateway elements (GoKwik) may not be fully under our control. We are working with our payment provider to ensure maximum accessibility compliance.

Feedback & Contact

We welcome feedback on the accessibility of our website. If you experience barriers to access, please contact us:

Email: ascovitahealthcare@gmail.com
Phone: +91 9898 582 650
Address: Near Rajshivalay Cinema, Anand – 388001, Gujarat, India

We aim to respond to accessibility feedback within 2 business days.

Subscription FAQs

Can I cancel my subscription anytime?

Yes, absolutely. You can cancel, pause, or modify your subscription at any time from your Account Dashboard with zero penalties. Cancellations take effect before the next scheduled delivery.

How do subscription payments work?

Payment is charged automatically via your saved payment method (card/UPI) before each scheduled delivery. You'll receive a reminder email 3 days before each charge.

Can I change my product between deliveries?

Yes. Log in to your account dashboard and update your subscription product selection at least 5 days before the next scheduled delivery date.

Is the subscription discount applied immediately?

Yes. The discount applies from your very first subscription order and every order thereafter as long as your subscription remains active.
